rationale: Branch tips resolved 2026-04-30 via `git ls-remote`. zetajs@1.2.0 (published 2025-05-30) tracks the distro/allotropia/zeta-24-2 branch tip via cdn.zetaoffice.net/zetaoffice_latest/ — no published compatibility matrix, so we adopt the same policy and freeze a snapshot. The renderer in client/ink is already proven to work against the live CDN, which is built off this branch's most recent commits, so the tip-at-resolution-time is the most defensible pin. Update procedure: re-run `git ls-remote` for the three branches, replace the shas, capture the new date here, build + smoke-test, tag. Never rebuild without bumping the pin — same versions.json on a different day = different commits = silently re-rolled ABI dice.
